name: Valles Marineris
description: A vast canyon system stretching across nearly a quarter of the planet. Its immense walls expose billions of years of Martian geology.

name: Olympus Mons
description: The largest volcano in the solar system, rising above the surrounding Tharsis plains.

name: Jezero Crater
description: An ancient lake basin with a preserved river delta, explored by NASA’s Perseverance rover.

name: Gale Crater
description: Home to Mount Sharp and the Curiosity rover, with sedimentary layers recording a changing climate.

name: Hellas Planitia
description: One of the deepest and largest impact basins on Mars, prone to seasonal dust activity.

name: Utopia Planitia
description: A broad northern lowland basin visited by Viking 2 and Zhurong.

name: Elysium Mons
description: The principal volcano of the Elysium volcanic province.

name: Arsia Mons
description: The southernmost of the three great Tharsis Montes volcanoes.

name: Meridiani Planum
description: An equatorial plain with hematite deposits and the landing site of Opportunity.

name: Viking 1
description: The first successful long-lived lander on Mars, in Chryse Planitia.

name: Viking 2
description: NASA’s second Viking lander, on the rocky plains of Utopia.

name: Pathfinder
description: Delivered Sojourner, the first Mars rover, to Ares Vallis.

name: Spirit
description: Explored Gusev Crater before becoming embedded in soft soil at Troy.

name: Opportunity
description: Explored Meridiani Planum for nearly fifteen years.

name: Phoenix
description: Investigated water ice in the northern polar plains.

name: Curiosity
description: NASA’s mobile laboratory in Gale Crater.

name: InSight
description: Studied Mars’s interior from Elysium Planitia.

name: Perseverance
description: Collecting rock samples and exploring the ancient Jezero delta.

name: Zhurong
description: China’s first Mars rover, in southern Utopia Planitia.
